verdict.rationale: The docs show a plugin ecosystem for many AI providers, with STT interfaces whose API key and base URL can be overridden, so developers can choose and swap their STT provider. Nothing in the evidence documents transcription accuracy, real-time transcript output, language or model selection, or key-term boosting. missing for 10: documented real-time transcription output, accuracy evidence, language/model selection controls, key-term/keyword boosting, independent hands-on corroboration.
